text:
Rhea Kapoor: Customer reported an odd billing delta after a truncated stream + cross-route reconnect. Ledger shows provisional on route A, truncated confirm on route A, then reconnect to route B which confirmed remainder -> ledger ended up with provisional>confirmed but confirmed credited on different route causing ops confusion. Has anyone seen combined truncate+cross-route issues?

Ben Hart: could you paste a short ledger snippet?

Rhea Kapoor: trace tx-1999990000: ```
2026-08-05T10:00:01Z TRACE tx-1999990000 sess=0x55 toolcall=tc-x provisional=100 route=A
2026-08-05T10:00:03Z WARN sess=0x55 toolcall=tc-x truncated=60 reason=max_tokens route=A
2026-08-05T10:00:05Z INFO reconnect sess=0x56 route=B resume_suffix=40
2026-08-05T10:00:06Z TRACE tx-1999990000 sess=0x56 toolcall_confirm=tc-x confirmed=40 route=B
# net: provisional 100, confirmed 100 but split across routes; ops couldn't find which provisional to clear
```

billing-bot: Alert BILL-12099 logged: cross-route truncate accounting mismatch for acct ac-555.

Zoe Kim: root cause looks like provisional markers are per-route and truncation emits partial confirm but doesn't shrink provisional on the original route. Then confirm on the new route sets confirmed there, leaving the original provisional lingering. Two vectors: per-route scoping of provisional and lack of shrink-on-truncate.

Ben Hart: short-term fix: on truncate emit a provisional_shrink event that targets the original route's provisional entry (billing.adjust_on_truncate=true behind flag). Also on confirm search for stale provisionals for same toolcall across routes and decrement them if matched.

Rhea Kapoor: long-term: canonicalize provisional ownership globally keyed by toolcall_id+session_owner so confirms and truncates operate on the same logical record regardless of route. That will also help with reconciler logic.

Zoe Kim: console improvements: add a per-toolcall "provisional by route" view and a timeline showing truncate events. Ops should get a clear mapping instead of hunting across route dashboards.

Ben Hart: I'll open ENG-8123 with repro harness and suggested patch. Will include unit tests for race between truncate, reconnect, and confirm.

billing-bot: Acknowledged. Holding affected invoices pending reconciliation. Ticket BILL-12099 created.

Rhea Kapoor: thanks team. Posting repro + PR link in the issue when ready. Closing thread for now.
